the intelligentsia, as a lifestyle group that was consolidated under communism, has disintegrated.
the intelligentsia lifestyle has disintegrated, and that this has contributed to the decline in political activity among young adults in post‐communist eastern Europe.
the post‐communist intelligentsia stratum is disintegrating and that the intelligentsia lifestyle is being transformed into a new, commercialized form.
In summary, our research is concerned with

the political consequences of the disintegration of a particular social stratum, and with the political consequences for the former communist countries in question of their transition to a consumer culture.
the impact of post‐communist transformation on the intelligentsia as a lifestyle group.
the impact of the demise of communist regimes on the leisure lives of their young people and the impact of these leisure lives on their political lives.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the decline in political interest is due to a combination of factors, including the decline of the intelligentsias, the decline of the communist party, and the spread and commercialization of leisure.
